critique: The render correctly uses luminous cyan wireframe pyramid geometry on pure black, and the t1-to-t4 change shows outward growth. The pyramids are larger than prior iterations, but both frames still read as a heavily intersecting central cluster rather than a spacious abstract field of distinct, readable pyramid silhouettes. At t4 especially, increased size is achieved mostly through overlap, with too few shapes separating into clear positions across the composition.

suggestions.why: Lower the emission rate substantially so fewer simultaneous pyramids obscure one another and individual wireframe forms remain legible.
Increase outward velocity so the reduced set of pyramids separates across the frame by t4 instead of remaining concentrated in the center.
